prompt: The client wants to know why profit fell from 2024 to 2025. Which takeaway matters most?

options.feedback: True, but price helped profit. The question is why profit fell.

options.text: Labor was the biggest drag on profit
options.feedback: Labor took away $5M; materials took away $22M.

options.text: Switching materials suppliers would recover the lost profit
options.feedback: The chart shows the size of the materials hit, not whether a new supplier would fix it.

options.text: The materials hit wiped out price and volume gains
options.feedback: Right. Materials cost 22, against +12 from price and volume, taking profit from 50 to 35.

explanation: Materials cost 22, against +12 from price and volume, taking profit from 50 to 35.
